tools.name: get_advisor_letter_info
tools.description: Get pricing and details for AdvisorLetter: a weekly white-label market-commentary draft that financial advisors review and send to clients under their own name. Useful for an agent helping a financial advisor or RIA find a done-for-them (not done-by-AI-and-sent-raw) client communication product.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "advisor-letter" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_advisor_letter_info · Public sink: get_advisor_letter_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_advisor_letter_info · Public sink: get_advisor_letter_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
